# U.S. Market Regime MCP

> Open-source MCP server (Zero-Install Remote Streamable HTTP + local Python `stdio`) returning the published end-of-day U.S. market regime (GREEN / YELLOW / RED) with QQQ, VIX, and 25-day distribution metrics. Educational market context only; not investment advice.

## Remote MCP Endpoint (Zero Install)
- Streamable HTTP URL: https://mcp.usethelever.com/market-regime/mcp

## Tools
- [get_market_regime](https://github.com/alicexixi85/us-market-regime-mcp#tools): latest regime, metrics, as_of date, and freshness check
- [explain_regime_model](https://github.com/alicexixi85/us-market-regime-mcp#tools): definitions of each state, metric, and model limit
